sv.title: Prinsessan Estelles skola efter NMR-skandalen
sv.summary: När elever på prinsessan Estelles skola röstade på NMR så ringde nazisterna. Men det var inte de som var värst. – De var trevligare i sin ton än vad vänstersidan var, säger Martin Malmberg, skolchef på Campus Manilla.

en.title: Princess Estelle's school after the NMR scandal
en.summary: When pupils at Princess Estelle's school voted for NMR, the Nazis called. But they were not the worst. "They were friendlier in their tone than the left was," says Martin Malmberg, head of Campus Manilla.
